title: Every tredoku pattern admits a digit filling
description:
Every tredoku pattern can be filled with the digits 1–9 so that every diamond, and every line of nine cells along every run of three diamonds, contains each digit exactly once. This proves the conjecture in S. R. Blackburn, Tredoku patterns, Electron. J. Combin. 33(3) (2026) #P3.58, concluding remarks item 2. More generally, for every q ≥ 2 and every finite set of non-overlapping lozenges subdivided q×q there is a labelling by (ℤ/q)² that is complete on every tile and on every line along every run of exactly q tiles.

Contents: four-page manuscript (PDF, TeX), proof outline, partial logical-core Lean 4 formalization with axiom audit, corroborating geometric verification with a negative control, audit summaries, interactive 3D explorer. Version 1.0.1 adds only this archive metadata to the reviewed Version 1.0.0.
